parts.t: Grandview Heights is a growing part of South Surrey, close to Grandview Corners shopping and the aquatic centre. A half duplex here gives you a newer home with its own entrance and yard without buying a

This page shows duplexes and half duplexes for sale in Grandview Surrey, the Paragon (MLS) name for South Surrey's Grandview Heights area. A half duplex is one side of a building split into two homes. You own your side, and you share one wall with the neighbour.

Grandview Heights is planned by the City of Surrey under the Grandview Heights General Land Use Plan. Its neighbourhood plan areas include Morgan Heights, Sunnyside Heights, Darts Hill, Redwood Heights, Orchard Grove and Grandview Heights, with Agricultural Land Reserve land on the east side. For the full picture, read my
Grandview Heights guide
, or see every home type on my
Grandview Surrey homes for sale
page.

Grandview Corners, at 24 Avenue and 160 Street, is the main shopping area, with Grandview Central and a Walmart Supercentre nearby on 160 Street. Bus 354 runs along 160 Street, and routes 351 and 352 stop at the South Surrey Park & Ride.

Schools in the area include Edgewood Elementary (16666 23 Avenue), Sunnyside Elementary (2828 159 Street), Pacific Heights Elementary (17148 26 Avenue) and Grandview Heights Secondary (16987 25 Avenue). Catchment depends on the address, so check the Surrey Schools School Locator. The Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre is at 16855 24 Avenue.

A duplex, in the City of Surrey's words, is a residential building split into two principal homes. In Grandview most are side-by-side pairs built as part of a newer subdivision, so each half looks like a narrow house with its own front door. MLS lists each side separately as a half duplex.

Newer Grandview duplexes are often a two-unit strata. That means a strata corporation, bylaws and a Form B, even though there are only two owners and the "council" may just be the two of you. Others share one title and depend on a party-wall agreement registered on title for the shared wall and roof. Some are on two separate lots. Ask for the title and any strata plan at the start, because the setup changes what you'll be responsible for.

Surrey lets each half of a duplex have one secondary suite, matching the BC Building Code's one-suite-per-home limit. On a newer build, ask whether the suite was part of the original permit or added later. If it was added, ask to see the permit. The City has said the newer zoning rules don't make an unpermitted suite legal after the fact.

Look up any Grandview lot in the City's COSMOS map to see its zone under Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000. Many newer lots here are Comprehensive Development (CD) zones, each with site-specific rules, so what one street allows may not apply on the next. The old RF-SD semi-detached zone is now R6, and RF and RF-SS are now R3.

Surrey's small-scale multi-unit housing rules cover lots under 4,050 m² in zones RA, R1 to R5, R5-S and R6, and CD lots depending on size. Lots under 280 m² usually get up to 3 units, larger ones up to 4, and lots of at least 281 m² near a bus stop with 15-minute service can get up to 6. COSMOS or Schedule F of the bylaw will tell you if a lot qualifies.

A few things can still hold a project back: the City's review of sewer, water and drainage capacity, any Section 219 covenant on title, and a farm protection development permit for lots near the ALR edge on the east side of Grandview.

What is a half duplex in Grandview?
A home that shares one wall with a single neighbouring home in the same building. Your side is yours.
Is "Grandview Surrey" the official name?
No. The City of Surrey plans the area as Grandview Heights. Grandview Surrey is the Paragon sub-area name.
Are newer Grandview duplexes strata?
Many are two-unit stratas, but some share one title with a party-wall agreement, and others sit on two lots. Check the title.
What zone applies?
Many newer lots are CD zones with their own rules. Older duplex lots are R6, the former RF-SD. Look each lot up in COSMOS.
Can I add a suite?
Surrey allows one secondary suite per half. It has to be built with permits to be legal.
Can a Grandview lot have up to 6 units?
Only if it's eligible, is 281 m² or larger, and sits within 400 m of a bus stop with 15-minute service. Schedule F or COSMOS will confirm.
Which secondary school is in Grandview Heights?
Grandview Heights Secondary at 16987 25 Avenue. Check the School Locator for the catchment of a specific address.
